description: This file contains the implementation of a slow-consuming grain and its observer for Orleans streams, used for testing slow consumption behavior by repeatedly rewinding to the first received item.

classes.name: SlowConsumingGrain
classes.description: A grain that mimics slow consumption behavior by repeatedly rewinding to the first received item.

classes.name: SlowObserver<T>
classes.description: An observer that keeps rewinding to the first item to simulate slow consumption.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, initializes the consumer handle.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns the number of items consumed.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes the grain to a stream as a consumer.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Processes incoming stream items, rewinding to the first token to simulate slow consumption.
